Cyclist of 7 : 7, 9, 3, 1 (After every 4 values, the pattern is repeating)

Therefore, 86/4 i.e. Remainder = 2

If θ is a positive acute angle and tan 2θ tan 3θ = 1, then find the value of: 2 cos2 
5θ_________2
  - 1 

यदि θ एक धनात्मक न्यून कोण है और tan 2θ tan 3θ = 1, तो 2 cos25θ/2 - 1 का मान ज्ञात करें|
questions.solution:
tan 2θ tan 3θ = 1

tan 3θ = 1/tan 2θ = cot 2θ

tan 3θ = tan (π/2 - 2θ)

3θ = π/2 - 2θ or θ = π/10

Hence, 2 cos2 (5θ/2) - 1 = cos 5θ = cos (π/2) = 0

questions.question: If x + 1/16x = 1, then 64x 3 + 1/64x 3 will be यदि x + 1/16x = 1 है, तो 64x 3 + 1/64x 3 होगा-
questions.solution:
x + 1/16x = 1

Multiplying by 4 on both sides

4x + 1/4x = 4

Cube both sides

(4x + 1/4x)3 = (4x)3 + (1/4x)3 + 3*4x*1/4x* (4x + 1/4x)

64 = 64x3 + 1/64x3 + 3*4

64x3 + 1/64x3 = 64 - 12 = 52

questions.question: [(3 - 4 sin 2 x)/cos 2 x]+ tan 2 x = ? [(3 - 4 sin 2 x)/cos 2 x]+ tan 2 x = ?
questions.questionHtml:
[(3 - 4 sin2x)/cos2x]+ tan2x = ?

[(3 - 4 sin2x)/cos2x]+ tan2x = ?
questions.solution:
[(3 - 4 sin2x)/cos2x]+ tan2x = 3(sec x)2 - 4(tan x)2 + (tan x)2

= 3(sec x)2 - 3(tan x)2

= 3((sec x)2 - (tan x)2)

= 3
